purpose: Determine whether the v094c/v094e yield pathology is primarily caused by repeated persistent astronomical sources plus control-catalogue incompleteness/depth differences, by abnormally duplicated/non-independent science catalogues, or by local random-coincidence density. Do this before candidate inspection, registration, threshold changes, or corrected population construction.

allowed_inputs.v094e_per_triplet_aggregate: read-only; contains no candidate coordinates/source IDs
allowed_inputs.v094c_frozen_minimal_source_caches: read-only source_id/ra/dec arrays; source identifiers may be used only to derive process_id provenance and are never emitted
allowed_inputs.applause_dr4.process: network acquisition allowed only for fixed process-level fields and process IDs derived from frozen source caches; no source/candidate query

fixed_null_test.population: positive representatives that pass frozen all-three coverage and frozen control mismatch >5 arcsec
fixed_null_test.shift_validity: shifted coordinate must remain inside at least one independent scan solution polygon
fixed_null_test.interpretation: shifted matches estimate local chance-coincidence density while breaking the original positive-independent positional association

prospective_questions: Does the observed positive-independent confirmation excess remain far above local shifted-position chance coincidence, especially in matchable ordinals 251-275 and 251-300?
Are nominally independent science catalogues exact or near-exact duplicates at a level inconsistent with independent plate processing?
Do different scan IDs or different plate IDs share exact calibrated-coordinate catalogue fingerprints or a source-derived process_id?
Are high-yield triplets associated with controls having substantially fewer calibrated sources than the positive/independent science scans?
Are high-yield triplets associated with process-level source-count, true-source fraction, artifact fraction, faint-limit, calibration, or processing differences between science and control roles?
Which archive-role combinations carry the aggregate pathology?
Does the repeated-row inflation arise mainly from reusing the same positive plate/source opportunity across multiple controls rather than independent physical events?
interpretive_boundary: v094f diagnoses catalogue independence, local chance coincidence, and completeness/depth proxies. It does not establish that any source is transient or persistent at candidate level, does not qualify a catalogue absence, and does not define or execute the corrected Branch A/B/C population.
next_stop: Interpret v094f mechanism evidence before corrected-population design, candidate inspection, or registration.
